reports_published_check.name: reports_published_check
reports_published_check.value: ("reports"."status" = 'published') = ("reports"."snapshot" is not null and "reports"."published_at" is not null)

invitations_client_shape_check.name: invitations_client_shape_check
invitations_client_shape_check.value: ("invitations"."user_type" = 'client') = ("invitations"."client_id" is not null and "invitations"."client_role_id" is not null)

annotations_position_check.name: annotations_position_check
annotations_position_check.value:
("annotations"."kind" <> 'point' or ("annotations"."x" between 0 and 1 and "annotations"."y" between 0 and 1 and "annotations"."file_id" is not null))
        and ("annotations"."kind" <> 'timestamp' or ("annotations"."time_seconds" >= 0 and "annotations"."file_id" is not null))

tasks_dates_check.name: tasks_dates_check
tasks_dates_check.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."due_date" is null or "tasks"."start_date" <= "tasks"."due_date"

crm_activities_parent_check.name: crm_activities_parent_check
crm_activities_parent_check.value: "crm_activities"."lead_id" is not null or "crm_activities"."deal_id" is not null

leads_contact_check.name: leads_contact_check
leads_contact_check.value: "leads"."phone" is not null or "leads"."email" is not null
